source.original_text:
For the completed Euclidean Itô process staying in a compact K throughout the horizon almost surely, and a scalar test twice continuously Fréchet differentiable at every point of K, the sum of second-order Taylor residuals along its dyadic increments converges in measure to zero.

The positive horizon is T. The sample measure is finite, the filtration satisfies the usual conditions, and the driving standard vector Brownian motion is relative to that filtration and measure.
The finite coordinate rows have progressive product-square-integrable diffusion coefficients. Their drift evaluations at each fixed time t≤T are almost-everywhere strongly measurable.
The drift paths are almost surely continuous and have bounded variation on [0,T].
The compact set K has a selected fallback point k₀. On one event of full measure, the process belongs to K at every time in [0,T]. The test is twice continuously Fréchet differentiable at each point of that range.

\sum_i\left(f(X_{t_{i+1}})-f(X_{t_i})-Df(X_{t_i})[\Delta_iX]-\tfrac12D^2f(X_{t_i})[\Delta_iX,\Delta_iX]\right)\xrightarrow{\mu}0.

blind_reconstruction.text:
Finite state type I and Brownian type J; eta_ij; finite-variation coordinate processes A_i; resulting X; compact K and fallback∈K; scalar f. Second-order Taylor remainder R_f.

Omega is measurable with finite measure mu and a filtration F indexed by nonnegative reals. T>0 is fixed. The Euclidean coordinate type J is finite with decidable equality. B:[0,infinity)×Omega→R^J. lambda_T denotes the pullback under NNReal.toReal of Lebesgue measure restricted to [0,T]. I is finite. No DecidableEq I argument is required. A_i:[0,infinity)×Omega→R; X:[0,infinity)×Omega→R^I; f:R^I→R; K⊆R^I.

Assumptions: B starts at zero for every omega, has jointly independent increments over disjoint half-open intervals, every continuous real linear functional ell sends B_t-B_s (s<t) to a centered Gaussian of variance (t-s)||ell||², and paths are continuous mu-a.e. B is strongly adapted to F and B_t-B_s is independent of F_s for s≤t. F is right-continuous and every subset S⊆Omega with mu(S)=0 belongs to F_t for every t≥0. A progressive L² integrand is a real process a(t,omega), strongly progressive for F, for which (omega,t)↦a(t,omega) is in L²(mu⊗lambda_T). For every i and t≤T, A_i(t,·) is mu-a.e. strongly measurable. For every i, mu-a.e. omega, A_i(·,omega) is continuous and of bounded variation on [0,T]. K compact, fallback∈K; f is ambient C² at every point of K. On one mu-full set, X(t,omega)∈K for every t≤T. No progressivity of A_i is explicitly assumed.

Conclusion: I_j(a)(t,omega) denotes the specified completed Ito integral driven by the scalar coordinate B^j(t,omega)=(B(t,omega))_j. Its representative is the pointwise limit of chosen elementary stochastic integrals off the null complement of their uniform Cauchy event, and zero on that complement; it is held constant after T. Define X_i(t)=A_i(t)+∑_j I_j(eta_ij)(t), t_r^n=rT/2^n, Delta_r^n X=X(t_{r+1}^n)-X(t_r^n). With R_f(x,v)=f(x+v)-f(x)-Df(x)[v]-(1/2)D²f(x)[v,v], the functions ∑_{r=0}^{2^n-1}R_f(X(t_r^n),Delta_r^n X) converge in mu-measure to zero.

Quantifier order: Universally quantify setup, A, compact K, fallback and f. Under the full-measure all-time range condition X(t,omega)∈K for t≤T, the stated dyadic sums converge in measure.

Scope: Fixed positive horizon; dyadic sequence n→infinity; convergence in measure only. A_i need not be given as a drift integral. Path and range hypotheses are almost sure and simultaneous in time, whereas A_i's marginal measurability is for each time.

Constant dependencies: No unspecified numerical constants or convergence rate; fallback is supplied but does not occur in the displayed limit.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.CompactStateRepresentative
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoEuclideanRowRegularity
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoEuclideanTaylorRemainder
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoDyadicPrefixQV

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoActualTaylorRemainder

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped BigOperators NNReal
open BrownianMotion ProgressiveL2 ElementaryItoIntegral SampledElementaryApproximation
  DyadicElementaryRefinement EuclideanBrownianCoordinates ItoIntegralProcess ItoDyadicPrefixQV
  ItoEuclideanRowRegularity ItoEuclideanTaylorRemainder
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.CompactTaylorRemainder

open CompactStateRepresentative

/-- The dyadic second-order Taylor residual of the actual completed
Euclidean Itô process vanishes in measure. -/
theorem tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_actual_ito_taylor_remainder
    {Ω I J : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    {filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Ω)}
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {T : ℝ≥0}
    {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ J}
    (hB : IsStandardBrownianMotionWithFiltration B filtration μ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hUsual : SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration μ)
    (η : I → J → ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration μ T) (A : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hAmeas : ∀ i t, t ≤ T → AEStronglyMeasurable (A i t) μ)
    (hA : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ContinuousOn (fun t => A i t ω) (Icc 0 T) ∧
      BoundedVariationOn (fun t => A i t ω) (Icc 0 T))
    {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ I)} (hK : IsCompact K) (fallback : K) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ I → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ K, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) :
    let X := fun (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : I => A i t ω + ∑ j : J,
      itoIntegralProcess (η i j) hT ((coordinateFamily hB).isBrownian j) hUsual t ω)
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ t ≤ T, X t ω ∈ K) →
    TendstoInMeasure μ (fun n ω =>
      let t := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
      ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), secondOrderRemainder f (X (t i.castSucc) ω)
        (X (t i.succ) ω - X (t i.castSucc) ω)) atTop (fun _ => 0) := by
  intro X hRange
  let t (n : ℕ) := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
  let Y (s : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : K := restrictState fallback (X (min s T) ω)
  have ht (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n + 1)) : t n i ≤ T :=
    ((regularGridTimes_strictMono (dyadicMesh_pos hT n) _).monotone (Fin.le_last i)).trans_eq
      (regularDyadic_last_time T n)
  obtain ⟨hXm, hXc⟩ := measurable_continuousOn_euclidean_ito_rows
    hB hT hUsual η A hAmeas (fun i => (hA i).mono fun _ h => h.1)
  have hY (s : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (Y s) :=
    (measurable_restrictState hK.isClosed.measurableSet fallback).comp
      (hXm _ (min_le_right s T))
  have hYc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ContinuousOn (fun s => Y s ω) (Icc 0 T) := by
    filter_upwards [hXc, hRange] with ω hω hr
    apply Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.continuousOn_iff.2
    refine hω.congr fun s hs => ?_
    change (restrictState fallback (X (min s T) ω) : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) = X s ω
    rw [min_eq_left hs.2, coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr s hs.2)]
  let Q (i : I) (ω : Ω) :=
    ∑ j : J, ∫ s in Iic T, (η i j).process s ω ^ 2 ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)
  have hQV (j : I) : TendstoInMeasure μ (fun n ω =>
      ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), ((Y (t n i.succ) ω : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) j -
        (Y (t n i.castSucc) ω : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) j) ^ 2) atTop (Q j) := by
    have h := tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_prefix_sq_increments_of_ito_row hB hT hUsual
      (η j) (A j) (hAmeas j) (hA j) 0 (Fin.last (2 ^ (0 : ℕ)))
    simp only [regularDyadic_last_time] at h
    apply TendstoInMeasure.congr_left ?_ h
    intro n
    filter_upwards [hRange] with ω hr
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    have hs : regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n) i.succ ≤ T := ht n i.succ
    simp only [if_pos hs, Y, min_eq_left (ht n i.succ), min_eq_left (ht n i.castSucc),
      coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr _ (ht n i.succ)),
      coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr _ (ht n i.castSucc))]
    rfl
  have h := tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_sum_secondOrderRemainder_of_coordinate_qv
    hK f hf hT Y hY hYc Q hQV
  apply TendstoInMeasure.congr_left ?_ h
  intro n
  filter_upwards [hRange] with ω hr
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  change secondOrderRemainder f (Y (t n i.castSucc) ω : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)
    ((Y (t n i.succ) ω : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) - Y (t n i.castSucc) ω) = _
  dsimp only [Y]
  rw [min_eq_left (ht n i.succ), min_eq_left (ht n i.castSucc),
    coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr _ (ht n i.succ)),
    coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr _ (ht n i.castSucc))]

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoActualTaylorRemainder

steps.title: Place the paths in the compact range
steps.text: Clip the time at T and apply the Borel fallback outside K. On the event where the original path stays in K, the resulting K-valued path agrees with it at every dyadic grid point.
steps.lean:
intro X hRange
  let t (n : ℕ) := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
  let Y (s : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : K := restrictState fallback (X (min s T) ω)
  have ht (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ n + 1)) : t n i ≤ T :=
    ((regularGridTimes_strictMono (dyadicMesh_pos hT n) _).monotone (Fin.le_last i)).trans_eq
      (regularDyadic_last_time T n)
  obtain ⟨hXm, hXc⟩ := measurable_continuousOn_euclidean_ito_rows
    hB hT hUsual η A hAmeas (fun i => (hA i).mono fun _ h => h.1)
  have hY (s : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (Y s) :=
    (measurable_restrictState hK.isClosed.measurableSet fallback).comp
      (hXm _ (min_le_right s T))
  have hYc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ContinuousOn (fun s => Y s ω) (Icc 0 T) := by
    filter_upwards [hXc, hRange] with ω hω hr
    apply Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.continuousOn_iff.2
    refine hω.congr fun s hs => ?_
    change (restrictState fallback (X (min s T) ω) : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) = X s ω
    rw [min_eq_left hs.2, coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr s hs.2)]

steps.title: Derive the coordinate square-sum limits
steps.text: At the terminal grid point the inclusive prefix contains all fine cells. The scalar quadratic-variation theorem supplies the limit for each actual coordinate.
steps.lean:
let Q (i : I) (ω : Ω) :=
    ∑ j : J, ∫ s in Iic T, (η i j).process s ω ^ 2 ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)
  have hQV (j : I) : TendstoInMeasure μ (fun n ω =>
      ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), ((Y (t n i.succ) ω : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) j -
        (Y (t n i.castSucc) ω : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) j) ^ 2) atTop (Q j) := by
    have h := tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_prefix_sq_increments_of_ito_row hB hT hUsual
      (η j) (A j) (hAmeas j) (hA j) 0 (Fin.last (2 ^ (0 : ℕ)))
    simp only [regularDyadic_last_time] at h
    apply TendstoInMeasure.congr_left ?_ h
    intro n
    filter_upwards [hRange] with ω hr
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    have hs : regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n) i.succ ≤ T := ht n i.succ
    simp only [if_pos hs, Y, min_eq_left (ht n i.succ), min_eq_left (ht n i.castSucc),
      coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr _ (ht n i.succ)),
      coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr _ (ht n i.castSucc))]
    rfl

steps.title: Apply the Taylor residual estimate
steps.text: Apply the existing Euclidean residual theorem using these coordinate limits. Equality of the clipped and original paths on the grids gives the claimed sum.
steps.lean:
have h := tendstoInMeasure_dyadic_sum_secondOrderRemainder_of_coordinate_qv
    hK f hf hT Y hY hYc Q hQV
  apply TendstoInMeasure.congr_left ?_ h
  intro n
  filter_upwards [hRange] with ω hr
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  change secondOrderRemainder f (Y (t n i.castSucc) ω : EuclideanSpace ℝ I)
    ((Y (t n i.succ) ω : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) - Y (t n i.castSucc) ω) = _
  dsimp only [Y]
  rw [min_eq_left (ht n i.succ), min_eq_left (ht n i.castSucc),
    coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr _ (ht n i.succ)),
    coe_restrictState_of_mem fallback (hr _ (ht n i.castSucc))]
